system.description:
Favoured weapon: Staff

Granted power: Advantage on saves vs charm and enchantment. Once/day, as an action: each hostile creature within your Aura of Courage (10ft before 2nd level) makes a Will save or is calmed for 1 minute; harming it ends the calm.

Allegiance: Neutral Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Eldath in the World of Arneyan wiki.
